submitted.rationale: Out of three merit measurements, index 14 (Ni0.55Sb0.45) had the highest EQE at 0.039%. That is about 3x the values at the Ni-rich point (index 8, 0.0138%) and at the NiSb2O6-stoichiometric point (index 21, 0.0120%). This suggests the EQE peaks in the middle of the composition range.
